ms.report:
The Identus engineers completed the third milestone of the Project Catalyst: Verifiable Data Registry for Identus in Cardano.
The corresponding outputs of the milestone are listed below, and include:
1. Cardano VDR Specification
The team has authored a formal specification for how a PRISM VDR driver should interact with the Cardano blockchain. This specification is published publicly and provides:
・The operational requirements of the driver (e.g., resolve, submit, verify operations)
・Expected input/output types and data encoding formats
・Ledger model interpretation
・Error handling and status reporting

Specification URL: Cardano VDR Specification
2. Driver Implementation
The team has implemented the full Cardano VDR driver according to the above specification. The driver is:
・Part of the open-source Identus ecosystem
・Capable of submitting DID storage operations (create, update, deactivate) to the Cardano ledger
・Structured as a modular Scala library for integration into PRISM agents and tooling, the indexer for the VDR data is implemented in Rust as a microservice.

Implementation repository, in Scala for the JVM target platform: prism-vdr-driver
Implementation repository, in Rust for indexing and a REST API endpoint to fetch the data: neoprism
Open API specification for the VDR REST API endpoint: openapi
Key components:
・Driver interface and ledger configuration logic
・Submitter implementation for Cardano
・Operation resolver
・Codec and format compatibility with DID Core
・VDR data indexer
・VDR REST API specification

3. Test Coverage
The VDR driver has been integrated and tested within the NeoPrism project, which serves as an end-to-end test harness for DID interactions on Cardano, including the VDR data entries.
Relevant test suites:
・CreateStorageOperationSuite.scala
・Covers valid and invalid storage operations using the Cardano VDR

CI evidence of test run: CI Run Result
